title: Phase 19 acceptance artifacts share a consolidated commit with unrelated parallel repairs
claim: The 19.11 task-owned acceptance artifacts (docs/audits bilingual pair and the verifier amendment) landed inside consolidated commit 4bf5fc0 that also carries unrelated opi-agent, opi-ai, and opi-coding-agent changes from parallel sessions, so per-task commit provenance for 19.11 cannot be isolated from the unrelated repairs without the ledger note.

evidence.detail: 221 crates/opi-eval paths alongside 24 opi-agent, 10 opi-ai, and 36 opi-coding-agent paths in the same window; every Phase 19 task_owned_paths list names only opi-eval and docs paths
the ledger records that task-owned paths landed in consolidated commit 4bf5fc0 authorized alongside parallel session fixes because no separate commit was possible on the clean tree
